sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Gross Margin Stability: Gross margin varied with a standard deviation of 4.1 percentage points. Margin volatility suggests commodity exposure or weak pricing power.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 4.7 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.
Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +4.9% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.
ROE vs. ROCE Quality: Return on capital employed of 6.8% with ROE of 4.6% is close to or below the cost of capital, so growth destroys rather than creates value.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 2 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 80 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
